title: Hierarchical safeguard lattice for gradient launches
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a structured runbook and lattice of rollout gates for gradient (multi-stage) launches. This ticket captures the milestone definitions, measurement cadence, evaluation windows, and escalation paths needed for safe A/B experiments, canary waves, and feature ramps. The goal is to reduce ambiguity during launches by standardizing: 1) minimum instrumentation and dashboards, 2) metric groups with primary/secondary/health signals, 3) pass/fail thresholds for each stage, 4) automated gating rules where possible, and 5) communication and rollback playbook. Deliverables: canonical runbook doc, templated dashboards, gating spec for the routing service, and a checklist for cross-functional approvals (PM/Eng/Design/SRE/Legal).
acceptance_criteria: Runbook doc approved by PM, Eng lead, and SRE
Metric map with primary, secondary, and health signals documented for two example experiments (chat generation latency + hallucination rate)
Gate definitions encoded as JSON schema and a validation test in the routing service repo (example gating rules for 0%, 1%, 10%, 50%)
Dashboards (Console) template created with burn-down and cohort-trended views, linked in the runbook
Escalation ladder with on-call contact and operating windows included
tasks: Draft initial runbook outlining stage names, durations, and metric windows
Workshop with SRE to align on SLO/health signal thresholds and instrumentation gaps
Prototype gating schema and submit RFC to infra-routing team
Create Console dashboard templates and share with Observability team
Run tabletop simulation with safety engineers and legal for high-customer-impact flows
